purpose: Project-agnostic rapid prototyping through project setup, platform foundation, Controller-owned platform merge, feature audit waves, central integration, and final source-level repair.

project_setup.new_project: The Controller records the owner-selected technology stack, repository plan, and relative directory plan before work begins.
project_setup.imported_project: The Controller binds the imported source readback and requires explicit owner approval before rapid development.

migration.rule: Existing feature worktrees and reports are adopted only after preservation and source-bound intake; missing platform parity remains an explicit hold.

pyramid.purpose: Platform agents establish the project skeleton, repositories, directories, technology baseline, routing, shared contracts, design direction, questions, and platform boundaries in isolated worktrees.
The Controller independently audits and repairs the platform candidates, integrates one cumulative platform worktree, and emits the source-bound feature-admission receipt.
Feature agents audit, repair, self-audit, and re-audit their isolated scopes from the accepted platform skeleton in rolling waves.
Central integrates compatible feature candidates into one fresh worktree, repairs the complete system, and owns the final merge.

inventory_parity.mismatch: active orchestration work; platform domains reuse an existing feature task and worktree; never fabricate a duplicate task or report; fail closed when any feature or governance lane is absent

visible_task_readback.rule: A shaped registry is not parity evidence. Every admitted visible task and worktree must also appear in an exact host list_threads readback bound to the project and campaign; missing, duplicated, archived, or synthetic identities hold admission. A task may be idle or not loaded, but it must remain visible and unarchived.
visible_task_readback.bootstrap_rule: Bootstrap obtains the readback directly from the bound host before workflow validation; caller-supplied lookalike receipts are ignored.

archive_rule: Preserve the handoff, prove downstream integration and stale-worktree closure, remove active scope, prove chat out of scope, then archive. If any condition is false, leave the task and worktree intact.
verification_rule: Use only project-declared checks. If automated verification is prohibited, report SOURCE_AUDITED_PROTOTYPE and do not claim mechanical readiness.
